(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Bandaraya Kuala Lumpur) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 Januari 2014.

dalam Jadual Kedua, melainkan dari arah yang ditentukan dalam ruang (2)

Jadual Pertama, mulai tarikh yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3) Jadual Pertama dilarang.

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(CITY OF KUALA LUMPUR) ORDER 2014

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 486 published on 20 December 2013, notice was given of the

intention to make an order under subsections 70(1) and (2) of the Road Transport

Act 1987 [Act 333];

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Dato Bandar Kuala Lumpur

against the making of such order;

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 70(1) of

the Act, the Dato Bandar Kuala Lumpur, after consultation with the Director General for

Road Transport, and after taking into consideration the matters referred to in

subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use

of Road) (City of Kuala Lumpur) Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 January 2014.

Prohibition

2. The driving of all vehicles on the part of the road as specified in column (1) of the

First Schedule, as shown on the map in the Second Schedule, otherwise than in the

directions specified in column (2) of the First Schedule, with effect from the date

specified in column (3) of the First Schedule is prohibited.
